UpdateKeyBudgetRequest.description: Set this key's spend budget. Omit an axis to leave it unlimited.

period.description: Window the budget is measured over

creditLimit.description: Credits this key may consume per window. Omit or null for unlimited.

amountLimit.description: Money this key may spend on top-ups per window. Omit or null for unlimited.

alertThreshold.description: Percent of the tightest limit at which this key starts reporting itself near its ceiling. 1-99, or null to never alert. Defaults to 80 when a budget is first set.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code; branch on this, not on message

KeyBudgetDto.description: What this API key may spend, and what it has spent in the current window

period.description: Rolling window the budget is measured over. Null when no budget is set.

creditLimit.description: Credits this key may consume per window. Null means unlimited.

creditsSpent.description: Credits consumed by this key in the current window

creditsRemaining.description: Credits still available to this key. Null when the credit budget is unlimited.

amountLimit.description: Money this key may spend on top-ups per window. Null means unlimited.

amountSpent.description: Money spent by this key in the current window

amountRemaining.description: Money still available to this key. Null when the spend budget is unlimited.

resetsAt.description: When the current window rolls over. Null for a TOTAL budget, which never resets.

percentUsed.description: How far through the tightest limit this key is, 0-100. Null when nothing is capped.

alertThreshold.description: Percent of the tightest limit at which this key reports itself near its ceiling. Null means it never does.

alerting.description: True once the threshold has been crossed in the current window

alertingSince.description: When the threshold was crossed in this window, or null if it has not been

email.description: For PERSON units: the address Claude Code reports them under.

githubLogin.description: For PERSON units: their GitHub login, so merged pull requests attribute to them.

parentId.description: Unit this one rolls up into (a team for a person, a project for a team). Optional.

featureId.description: PROJECT only: id of the serve-side feature it shipped. Null clears it.

dailyCents.description: Cents per UTC day. Null = no daily ceiling.

monthlyCents.description: Cents per calendar month. Null = no monthly ceiling.

alertThreshold.description: Percent of either ceiling that raises a THRESHOLD alert. Default 80.

dailySpentCents.description: Spend so far in the current UTC day / calendar month, for the unit including descendants.

effectiveMonthlyCents.description: The monthly ceiling in force right now: the bump while it lasts, else monthlyCents.

gatewaySpentCents.description: What the gateway itself has counted this month for the LiteLLM team/key/user this unit's rules name — the number LiteLLM enforces max_budget against, priced by its own model map. Null when the unit has no LiteLLM rule.

enforcementTarget.description: Where a Block budget is enforced as a hard limit (e.g. litellm:team:backend); null when advisory only.

enforcementError.description: Why the last push to the gateway failed; null when it worked or was never attempted.

slackWebhookUrl.description: Slack incoming webhook URL (https://hooks.slack.com/services/…). Stored encrypted. Empty string removes it; null leaves it alone.

webhookUrl.description: Generic webhook URL (https). Every alert and digest is POSTed as JSON with X-Tanso-Event. Stored encrypted. Empty string removes it; null leaves it alone.

webhookSecret.description: Signing secret: requests carry X-Tanso-Signature: sha256=HMAC-SHA256(secret, body). Empty string removes it; null leaves it alone.

alertEmails.description: Comma-separated recipients for alerts and the digest. Empty string removes them; null leaves them alone.

digestEnabled.description: Send the weekly digest on Monday 08:00 UTC.

personLevelEnabled.description: Whether spend may be attributed to named people (PERSON units, the by-person view).

workerNotice.description: What staff were told about spend attribution. Required to enable person level.

slackConfigured.description: A Slack incoming webhook is stored for alerts. The URL itself is never returned.

webhookConfigured.description: A generic webhook URL is stored. Never returned.

adminKey.description: The new vendor admin key. Stored encrypted; never returned.

keyHint.description: Last four characters of the admin key. The key itself is never returned.

scope.description: Provider scope: the GitHub organization for Copilot, the proxy URL for LiteLLM. Null for providers that have none.

lastError.description: Why the last probe or sync failed; null while healthy.

JwtResponse.description: Response containing the JWT authentication token

email.description: Contact email of the agent's principal — the human or org the agent buys for

name.description: Optional display name for the customer record

apiKey.description: Customer-scoped API key. Returned exactly once — store it now.

nextSteps.description: Where to go next: base URL, entitlement check, event ingestion, usage

apiKey.description: Plaintext key. Returned exactly once, at creation or rotation; never retrievable again.

budgetPeriod.description: Window this key's budget is measured over, or null when it has no budget

budgetCredits.description: Credits this key may consume per window. Null means unlimited.

budgetAmount.description: Money this key may spend per window. Null means unlimited.

monthlyCents.description: The monthly ceiling in cents while the bump lasts. Must be above the standing ceiling.

expiresAt.description: When the bump ends and the standing ceiling applies again.

reason.description: Why — shown on the budget and in the digest.

matchValue.description: Vendor workspace/project id (LiteLLM: team_id), API key id (LiteLLM: the key), or actor (Claude Code email / OpenAI user id / LiteLLM user_id).

priority.description: Lower wins when several rules match one row. Default 100.

fromModel.description: The model whose traffic to re-price, as it appears on the usage report.

toModel.description: A model in the price book.

workspaceId.description: Only traffic from this vendor workspace / project / team id. Null = all.

currentCents.description: What the matched traffic cost by the price book.

simulatedCents.description: The same tokens at the target model's rates.

deltaCents.description: simulated − current; negative is a saving.

caveats.description: Things the number does not know: quality, latency, token-count drift between tokenizers, missing cache rates.

externalId.description: Stable id in your system, e.g. a PR URL or ticket key. Posting the same id again updates the outcome.

actorEmail.description: Who did it, for attribution to a person (needs person level on).

spendUnitId.description: Unit to attribute to when no person matches. Optional.

aiAssisted.description: An AI assistant was in the work.

aiTool.description: Which one, if known: claude-code, copilot, cursor, codex, …

token.description: GitHub token with read access to the repos, or a Linear API key. Stored encrypted; never returned.

scope.description: GitHub: comma-separated owner/repo. Linear: comma-separated team keys, or * for all.

defaultSpendUnitId.description: Unit an outcome lands on when no person matches its author.

scope.description: GitHub: owner/repo list. Linear: team keys or *.

monthlySpentCents.description: Month-to-date against the effective monthly ceiling; null when the unit has no monthly budget.

delivery.description: Set by POST /digest/send: what happened on each channel.

label.description: How this org shows up in the console, e.g. "Anthropic — engineering org"

adminKey.description: Vendor admin key. Stored encrypted; never returned.

scope.description: Copilot: the GitHub organization (required). LiteLLM: the proxy URL, e.g. https://llm.internal:4000 (required). Other providers: ignored and not stored.

totalRevenue.description: Total revenue across events in this group

totalUsageUnits.description: Total usage units across events in this group

lastOccurredAt.description: Most recent event timestamp in this group

actor.description: Claude Code actor email or key name, or OpenAI user id.

vendorCostCents.description: The vendor's own estimate for this actor (Claude Code, Cursor charged); null when the vendor gives none.

requests.description: Per-person signals the vendor reports for the window; null where it reports none.

tool.description: Last tool seen: Claude Code terminal, Cursor model, Copilot surface.

requests.description: Null when the vendor does not report request counts for this model.

vendorCostCents.description: Cost-report rows the vendor attributed to this model; null when the vendor does not break cost down by model (OpenAI).

cacheRatesKnown.description: False when the price book has no cache rates for this model, so cached tokens were priced at the full input rate (an overestimate).

unpricedModels.description: Models seen in usage that the price book does not know; their metered cost is zero.

requests.description: Null when no vendor in the window reports request counts (Anthropic does not).

vendorCostCents.description: What the vendors' cost reports say, in cents.

meteredCostCents.description: What the price book says the tokens should cost, in cents.

inputCostCents.description: Input-side cost as billed: uncached at the input rate, cache reads and writes at their rates.

noCacheCostCents.description: The same input tokens with no cache: everything at the input rate.

savedCents.description: noCacheCostCents − inputCostCents. Negative when cache writes cost more than the reads saved.

cacheRatesKnown.description: False when the price book has no cache rates for the model — the row then assumes cache tokens cost the input rate, i.e. zero saving.

meteredIsEstimate.description: True when some model was unpriced or a cache rate was missing, so metered is a floor or a ceiling, not a figure.

invoicedCents.description: Sum of imported invoices whose period lies inside the window. Null when none.

buildCents.description: Metered AI spend attributed to the project and its descendants (build side).

revenueCents.description: Sum of revenueAmount on the feature's events in the window (serve side).

serveCostCents.description: Sum of costAmount on the feature's events in the window (serve side).

buildPerOutcomeCents.description: Build cost per outcome; null with no outcomes.

unlinkedProjects.description: PROJECT units with no feature linked — they have a build cost and no revenue to put beside it.

aiAssisted.description: Outcomes where an AI assistant was in the work (label, trailer, bot author, or said so when posted).

spendCents.description: Metered spend allocated to the unit and its descendants — the price-book figure, same basis for every row.

personEstimateCents.description: PERSON units only: the vendor's own Claude Code estimate. Shown beside, never inside, spendCents.

costPerOutcomeCents.description: spendCents / outcomes; null when the unit shipped nothing or has no metered spend to divide.
Total spend over total outcomes; null when there are no outcomes.

ownCents.description: Metered cents matched directly to this unit's rules.

totalCents.description: Own cents plus every descendant's own cents.

personEstimateCents.description: PERSON units only: the vendor's own per-person estimate (Claude Code). Not rolled up into parents — the same traffic already reaches the team through its key rules.

spendCents.description: What budgets are measured against: totalCents plus personEstimateCents.

unattributedCents.description: Metered cents no rule claimed. Always sums with the rows' own cents to totalMeteredCents.

personLevelEnabled.description: False when person-level attribution is off for the account; PERSON units then receive nothing.

PlanCreditAllocationDto.description: Data Transfer Object for Plan Credit Allocation

creditAmount.description: Number of credits allocated per period

grantExpiresMonths.description: Number of months before granted credits expire

hardLimit.description: Whether to block events when credits are depleted (true) or allow overage (false). Null inherits from credit model.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the allocation was created

PlanFeatureLinkedDto.description: Data Transfer Object representing a plan and its linked features

features.description: List of features linked to the plan

creditAllocations.description: Credit allocations configured for this plan

items.description: List of subscription revenue items in the current page

totalElements.description: Total number of elements across all pages

hasNext.description: Whether there are more pages after the current one

CustomerBulkResponse.description: Response containing a list of customers

CustomerElement.description: Simplified customer information for bulk display

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the customer was created

StripeApiKeysResponse.description: Response containing masked Stripe API keys for an account

RevenueBridgePeriodDto.description: Revenue breakdown for a single billing period

totalRevenue.description: Total revenue from all paid invoices in this period

creditAmount.description: Credit amounts applied in this period (negative)

netRevenue.description: Net revenue (totalRevenue, which already includes credits)

creditToRevenueRatio.description: Ratio of |creditAmount| to gross revenue (totalRevenue - creditAmount), null if gross is zero

customerCount.description: Number of distinct customers with paid invoices in this period

newCustomers.description: Number of customers new in this period vs the previous period

churnedCustomers.description: Number of customers in the previous period but not this one

RevenueBridgeResponseDto.description: Historical revenue bridge showing period-over-period revenue changes

periods.description: Revenue breakdown by billing period, ordered chronologically

AnalyticsResponseDto.description: Complete analytics response including portfolio summary and customer details

ChurnScoreDto.description: Composite churn risk score with signal breakdown

riskLabel.description: Risk label: low (0-25), moderate (26-50), high (51-75), critical (76-100)

totalCredits.description: Sum of all credit invoice amounts (negative value)

netEffectiveMrr.description: Net effective MRR after credits (totalEffectiveMrr + totalCredits)

creditToMrrRatio.description: Ratio of |totalCredits| to totalEffectiveMrr, null if totalEffectiveMrr is zero

CustomerAnalyticsDto.description: Analytics data for a single customer

planId.description: Unique identifier of the customer's plan

totalCost.description: Total cost from plan features in dollars

marginStatus.description: Margin health status: healthy (>=70%), at_risk (40-70%), underwater (<40%)

projectedUsageRevenue.description: Projected usage-based revenue for the current billing period

effectiveMrr.description: Effective MRR including projected usage revenue (mrr + projectedUsageRevenue)

rgp.description: Recurring gross profit (effectiveMrr - totalCost), null if no cost model

churnRisk.description: Churn risk: null, pending_cancel, or pending_downgrade

cancelEffectiveAt.description: When the cancellation takes effect, if applicable

churnScoreDetails.description: Detailed churn risk score with signal breakdown

totalCredits.description: Total credit invoice amounts for this customer, null if no credits

CustomersByStatus.description: Customer counts grouped by margin health status

healthy.description: Number of customers with healthy margins (>=70%)

atRisk.description: Number of customers with at-risk margins (40-70%)

underwater.description: Number of customers with underwater margins (<40%)

MrrByStatus.description: MRR amounts grouped by margin health status

healthy.description: MRR from customers with healthy margins

atRisk.description: MRR from customers with at-risk margins

underwater.description: MRR from customers with underwater margins

PortfolioSummaryDto.description: Summary analytics for the entire customer portfolio

totalMrr.description: Total monthly recurring revenue across all customers in dollars

totalCosts.description: Total costs across all customers in dollars

avgMargin.description: Average margin across all customers as a decimal (0.0 to 1.0)

ltv.description: Customer lifetime value (ARPU / monthly churn rate), null if churn is zero

nrr.description: Net revenue retention rate as a decimal (e.g., 1.05 = 105%), null if no historical data

pendingCancelCount.description: Number of customers with pending cancellations

pendingCancelMrr.description: MRR at risk from pending cancellations

pendingDowngradeCount.description: Number of customers with pending downgrades

totalProjectedUsageRevenue.description: Total projected usage-based revenue across all customers

totalEffectiveMrr.description: Total effective MRR including projected usage revenue (totalMrr + totalProjectedUsageRevenue)

rgpMargin.description: RGP margin (totalRgp / totalEffectiveMrr), null if totalEffectiveMrr is zero

avgChurnScore.description: Average churn risk score across scored customers

criticalChurnCount.description: Number of customers with critical churn risk (score >= 76)

highRiskMrr.description: MRR from customers with high or critical churn risk (score >= 51)

revenueBurnDown.description: Projected MRR loss over 30/60/90 day windows

topModelsByCost.description: Top models by cost across portfolio

ModelSummaryDto.description: Detailed analytics for a single LLM model

models.description: Per-model detailed analytics, sorted by cost desc
